content.short: Halliday is the Commerce Automation Platform for Modular Chains.
content.description: Halliday is a commerce automation platform for modular chains that lets users spend, manage, and transact with ease. It supports fiat-to-crypto conversions across appchains, custom blockchains, L1s, and L2s, and automates retries, gas payments, asset balances, transaction creation, batch scheduling, and network routing with a single click. Halliday enables atomic workflows and can aggregate balances across chains for purchases, swaps, or staking, all from one unified interface.

resources.title: Halliday: The First Workflow Protocol
resources.tldr: As chains and services multiplied, the hard part stopped being any single call and became sequencing them reliably. Sets out workflows as the missing abstraction.

resources.title: Dev Workshop: Building an Onramp to Any Chain
resources.tldr: Seven lines of code to a working onramp. Short, and a good measure of how far the integration burden for fiat-to-crypto has actually fallen.
